questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A slide with a frictionless curved surface becomes horizontal at its lower end on a terrace of height 3h. A spherical ball released from rest at height h above terrace leaves the slide horizontally with velocity u0 and lands on ground at distance d making angle θ with horizontal. It bounces with coefficient of restitution 1/√3 and reaches maximum height h1. Choose correct statements.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A plane polarized blue light ray is incident on a prism such that there is no reflection from surface. Angle of deviation is 60°. Angle of minimum deviation for red light from same prism is 30°. Refractive index for blue light is √3. Choose correct statements.

options.A: Blue light is polarized in plane of incidence
options.C: Refractive index for red light is √2
options.D: Angle of refraction for blue light in air at exit face is 60°

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: In the given circuit capacitor C is initially uncharged and key K is open. In this condition current of 1 A flows through 1Ω resistor. Key is closed at t=t0. Given e−1 =0.36. Choose correct statements.

options.B: For t<t0, current I1 is 2 A
options.C: At t=t0+7.2 μs current in capacitor is 0.6 A
options.D: For t→∞ charge on capacitor is 12 μC

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A bar of mass 1 kg and length 0.20 m lies on frictionless surface pivoted at one end. A particle of mass 0.10 kg moving with speed 5 m/s perpendicular to bar collides elastically at distance L/2 from pivot and rebounds. After collision bar rotates with angular velocity ω. Choose correct option.

options.A: ω = 6.98 rad s−1 and v = 4.30 m s−1
options.B: ω = 3.75 rad s−1 and v = 4.30 m s−1
options.C: ω = 3.75 rad s−1 and v = 10.0 m s−1
options.D: ω = 6.80 rad s−1 and v = 4.10 m s−1

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A container with conducting walls is being filled with dielectric liquid of dielectric constant 3 at rate 250 cm3/s. Base dimensions are 50 cm × 5 cm and height 50 cm. Find capacitance after 10 seconds.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: One mole ideal gas expands adiabatically from (TA,V0) to (Tf,5V0). Another mole expands isothermally from (TB,V0) to same final state. Ratio of specific heats is γ. Find TA/TB.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: Two satellites P and Q orbit Earth. hP = R/3 and gP/gQ = 36/25. Find hQ.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: A hydrogen-like atom with atomic number Z emits photons in transition n=4 to n=3. These photons produce photoelectric effect with maximum kinetic energy 1.95 eV. Threshold wavelength of metal is 310 nm. Find Z.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: An optical arrangement has two concave mirrors and one convex lens. Focal length of lens is 10 cm. Radii of curvature of mirrors are 20 cm and 24 cm. Object S is midpoint between lens and M2. If distance between lens and M1 is n/7 cm such that one image coincides with S, find n.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.questionText: In focal length determination of convex lens, object distance is 10±0.1 cm and image distance is 20±0.2 cm. Error in focal length determination is n%. Find n.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: Choose correct statements related to extraction of metals.

options.C: Copper pyrites is heated with silica in reverberatory furnace to remove iron
options.D: Impure silver is treated with aqueous KCN in presence of oxygen followed by reduction with zinc

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: In the given reaction sequence P,Q,R,S are major products. Choose correct statements about asymmetric carbons.

options.A: Both P and Q have asymmetric carbons
options.B: Both Q and R have asymmetric carbons
options.C: Both P and R have asymmetric carbons
options.D: P has asymmetric carbons and S has none

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: In the given reaction scheme involving styrene, choose correct options for products Q,R and S.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: In the reaction scheme involving metal halide, white precipitate P and filtrate Q, identify X and Y.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: Plotting 1/Λm against cΛm for monobasic weak acid HX gives straight line with intercept P and slope S. Find P/S.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: On decreasing pH from 7 to 2, solubility of sparingly soluble salt MX of weak acid HX increases from 10−4 M to 10−3 M. Find pKa of HX.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: In the given reaction scheme P is a phenyl alkyl ether and Q is aromatic compound. Identify correct statement about S.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: 516 g dimethyldichlorosilane reacts with water to give tetrameric cyclic product X in 75% yield. Find weight of X formed in grams.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: A gas has compressibility factor 0.5 and molar volume 0.4 dm3 mol−1 at 800 K and pressure x atm. If it behaves ideally at same temperature and pressure, molar volume becomes y dm3 mol−1. Find x/y.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.questionText: For reversible reaction A(g)⇌P(g), plot of log kf versus 1/T is given. Pre-exponential factors for forward and backward reactions are 10^15 s−1 and 10^11 s−1. If logK at 500 K is 6, find |log kb| at 250 K.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: Let S=(0,1)∪(1,2)∪(3,4) and T={0,1,2,3}. Choose correct statements.

options.A: There are infinitely many functions from S to T
options.B: There are infinitely many strictly increasing functions from S to T
options.C: Number of continuous functions from S to T is at most 120
options.D: Every continuous function from S to T is differentiable

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: T1 and T2 are common tangents to ellipse x²/6+y²/3=1 and parabola y²=12x. Choose correct statements.

options.A: Area of quadrilateral A1A2A3A4 is 35 sq units
options.B: Area of quadrilateral A1A2A3A4 is 36 sq units

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: For function f(x)=3x^5−9x^2+36x−17 over square S=[0,1]×[0,1], define green and red regions. Choose correct statements regarding line Lh.

options.A: Green area above equals green area below
options.B: Red area above equals red area below
options.C: Green area above equals red area below
options.D: Red area above equals green area below

questions.questionText: Point P lies on parabola y²=4ax. Normal at P meets x-axis at Q. Area of triangle PFQ is 120 where F is focus. If slope m of normal and a are positive integers, find (a,m).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: Find number of real solutions of equation cos(2x)+2tan−1(tanx)=1 in given interval.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.questionText: For piecewise function f(x) depending on parameter n, area bounded by x=0,x=1,y=0 and y=f(x) is 4. Find maximum value of function.
